domain: U : Set Real open; alpha, T, T', N, N', B, B' : Real -> (Fin 3 -> Real)
hypotheses: Derivative witnesses for alpha, T, N, B on U; Euclidean unit speed; kappa is the Euclidean norm of T' and is positive; N = kappa^-1 T'; B = T cross N; tau = -(B' dot N).
conclusion: At every s in U: T' = kappa N, N' = -kappa T + tau B, and B' = -tau N.
boundary_policy: Open domain avoids endpoint derivative conventions. Positive curvature excludes undefined principal normals. The standard coordinate dot product and cross product freeze metric and orientation; torsion sign is explicit.
status_boundary: Statement elaboration only. No proof, anchor-audit, H0/M0/R0, validation, release, or theorem-completion credit is claimed.
